How about we take a little walk?
The food here is so delicious.
Don't come between me and Kinuyo.
Why don't you join us, Hanamaru?
Did I say I was going back with you?
That's right.
That's not the case at all.
It's got nothing to do with you.
I'll explain everything later.
She must've misheard me.
It's just as Kinuyo said.

options.text: I just happened to run into her.
Don't you have the wrong person?
It doesn't matter whose regular I am.
We're just having fun together.
Kinuyo is just as important to me.
What lovely weather we're having today.
Cut it out, this isn't funny.
You two are very similar.
How about the three of us have some fun?
I don't know what you're talking about.
Hinagiku is like a sister to me.
You're both beauties.

options.text: Don't get in the way of a good time.
I don't recall ever saying that.
We're just having some fun together.
Kids should go back home.
I'm in the middle of something.
She's just a passerby.
It's just as Momochika said.
We're only walking around.
I'll explain everything later.
It's so difficult being a ladies' man.
I'm going to visit Shirayuki soon.
Stay out of our way.

meeting.note: If Hinagiku gives her ordinary arrival greeting, the English venue menu swaps Sushi Ginya and Hatsukaze Kitchen. Pick the displayed Hatsukaze Kitchen option to go to Sushi Ginya, or Sushi Ginya to go to Hatsukaze Kitchen. The labels match the destinations when you get her early-arrival greeting.

What Hinagiku said is true.
I felt bad for her.
It's just as Hinagiku said.
For sisters, you two don't look alike.
I was just pretending to be a regular.
I'm Hinagiku's regular.
She hasn't fully developed yet, go easy on her.
Are you jealous?
This is all Hinagiku's fault.
What Hinagiku is saying is true.
You're as beautiful as ever.

Actually, Kinuyo's the one for me.
Good one, Hanamaru.
We just ate together, that's all.
Hanamaru is a fine woman.
This isn't the place for a child.
I don't get it either.
I think I prefer Hinagiku after all.
Can't we all just be friends?
I wanted to make her jealous.
We're just old friends.
